args.title: Issue 4424: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The exported filename is constructed in formatExportFilename in src/exportUtils.ts. It uses the current Date() by default to generate the date suffix, ignoring the local timezone, which leads to the export downloaded at 6 pm LA time having tomorrow's date (UTC date). This causes the exported filename date to be off by one day in the evening in some time zones, explaining the issue.

args.title: Issue 4426: change src/types.ts
args.body:
File: src/types.ts

In src/types.ts, transaction amounts are represented as number type with the comment 'Integer minor units; negative for money going out.' This suggests amounts are stored as integers representing minor units, not floating-point numbers, which should avoid rounding errors. However, the use of the JavaScript number type for amounts can risk imprecision for very large numbers, so this file is central to explaining exactness and currency handling.

args.title: Issue 4429: change src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

In src/api/reports.ts, the duplicate report API appends ' (copy)' to the original report name but then truncates the resulting string to a maximum length of 120 characters, using truncate. For a report name near 120 characters, this leads to names ending with '...' instead of '(copy)', causing identical visible names for the original and duplicate, which matches the issue description.

args.title: Issue 4431: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The issue concerns losing non-Latin letters in exported report filenames. The responsible file is src/exportUtils.ts, particularly the function formatExportFilename, which uses slugify to create the file base name. The slugify function, found in src/util/strings.ts, drops accents and replaces all non-ASCII letters with hyphens, which removes Greek and Cyrillic characters entirely. This causes the exported filenames to lose non-Latin letters. Fixing this to preserve such characters would resolve the issue.

args.title: Issue 4434: change src/components/UploadForm.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The UploadForm component holds the upload error in 'problem' state and shows it until a new valid upload is submitted, but does not clear the error immediately when choosing a new file. The issue arises because the onChange handler sets the file but does not reset the problem state, so the old error message stays visible until another upload happens.
